description:
A `.sk` file: a focused scene with a planning table.
Unknown top-level fields must survive every runtime's decode -> save.

properties.name: locked
properties.description: Whether the whole sketch is protected from edits. Saved as `false` when unset.

properties.name: description
properties.description: Rich-text description (Lexical JSON, Markdown string, or null). Opaque.

type.description:
A row in the sketch planning table.
Unknown fields must survive every runtime's decode -> save.

properties.name: locked
properties.description: Whether the entire row is protected from edits. Saved as `false` when unset.

properties.name: locks
properties.description: Saved with all six fields, even when nothing is locked.

type.description: Per-cell lock state. Canonical save writes all six fields.

properties.name: screenshot
properties.description: Project-relative screenshot path. Canonical save writes `null` when absent.

properties.name: visual
properties.description: Project-relative Elucim visual path (legacy files may inline the document). Opaque.

type.description: Ranked normalized screenshot point used for camera moves.
A normalized text region rendered as a typewriter overlay.
Agent-generated camera motion plan for screenshot rows.

properties.name: kind
properties.description:
`subtle_push`, `wide_hold_then_push`, or `push_then_drift`.
A string until Typra emits matching Rust enum variant names for
multi-word values in generated tests.

type.description: Recorded or generated narration audio attached to a row.

properties.name: source_text
properties.description: Narrative text at the moment the audio was recorded or generated.

type.description: Durable creative direction and compiled SSML for generated narration.
A deliberate delivery beat for generated narration.
User-defined key/value metadata stored with portable documents.

properties.name: created_at
properties.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp. Runtimes never rewrite a timestamp they did not change.

properties.name: updated_at
properties.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp, set by every successful edit.
